written_before: any result for these sizes. Known before: the v1 grid (P4 12/4 Topstep 50K +$74-132 over 42 days, gate not met; 'results point at larger Combine sizes than 12 MNQ', flagged post hoc), state sizing FAIL, and LucidFlex negative at its indicative price.

policies.profit_stops: as v1: combine consistency_safe; funded funded_consistency_safe
policies.caps: sizes above a phase's max micros (or the scaling plan's start size, if the firm file states one) are cut to the cap; a policy whose cut duplicates another is reported once

firms: Topstep 50K standard: the 4 adapter variants (--topstep) and brain/_system/prop/firms/topstep_50k_standard.json (incl. $29/mo API)
LucidFlex 50K at indicative $165: brain/_system/prop/firms_indicative/lucid_flex_50k.json (reported, not selectable: price unverified)

split.why: same alternating split as PROP-STATE-SIZING-v1; resampling stays inside the half

selection: on train only: per firm file, the (eval, funded) size pair with the highest lower 90% bound of mean net cash
gate_on_test: the selected pair: mean net cash lower 90% bound > $0 AND (net - luck) lower 90% bound > $0; a pass then needs a confirmation run on test with a fresh seed and outer 200

settings.luck: the trial's matched random-direction control with the same sizes

honesty: every train cell is a prop trial; logged to prop_trials.jsonl with kind menu_v2; the test half is used once per firm file
